title: Lane reports + What's New
summary: A shared report builder any lane can call, plus a story changelog derived from git instead of hand-tagged — so review can start from a report instead of Storybook's sidebar.
changes: docs/build_lane_report.py — new: the shared report builder this file's own report was built with
docs/lane_report_manifest.example.json — new: this file — doubles as the worked example and the actual input used to build the report
docs/build_whats_new.mjs — new: derives apps/storybook-basics/src/stories/whats-new.generated.json from git, never hand-tagged
docs/capture_storybook_shots.mjs — added an opt-in --shots <file> flag so a lane can capture its OWN story list against its OWN port; unchanged for every existing caller that omits it
apps/storybook-basics/tsconfig.json — added "types": ["vite/client"] so import.meta.glob (the JSON-absent-is-not-a-build-error mechanism WhatsNew relies on) type-checks
.gitignore — whats-new.generated.json is generated, not committed — committing it is exactly the staleness hand-tagging would have had
findings: story-id derivation cross-checked against ALL 151 story exports in the app: 151/151 resolve, and all 7 ids hardcoded in capture_storybook_shots.mjs's own SHOTS list match byte-for-byte

one file (TraceRouting.stories.tsx) declares `const meta: Meta = {` with no trailing `satisfies Meta` — a plain string search for that marker (the first draft of this script) missed it; a string-aware brace matcher over the object literal does not
baseline preserved: pnpm test-stories 151 -> 155 (+4 new), pnpm exec vitest --project=unit 235 unchanged, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p . clean

R3 verified LIVE, not just asserted: with Storybook running on :5463, clicked 4 of the WhatsNew story links (Trace · Terminal Directions, Styles · Side By Side, Trace · Delayed Split, back to Timeline) and confirmed each one navigates the WHOLE Storybook window (target="_top", not just the preview iframe) to the real, distinct target story

R4 asserted, not just claimed: the Empty and MalformedData stories PASS explicit `data: undefined` / `data: { oldField: true }` as args and assert the empty-state test id renders — they do not merely delete the JSON and eyeball it

could not do this round: .storybook/preview.tsx storySort pinning (What's New sorts alphabetically today, after Trace, since no storySort is configured) and per-story tag injection — both explicitly out of scope, a concurrent lane owns .storybook/**
